title: Madinah sets Oct. 18 deadline for Ramadan iftar meal applications
summary: MADINAH — The Madinah Region Development Authority has announced the opening of applications for catering companies interested in providing iftar meals for the faithful at several locations across the region during Ramadan 1448 AH. Applications can be submitted electronically before the deadline closes on Jumada Al-Awwal 7, corresponding to Oct. 18. The authority stated that the designated sites include Al-Miqat Mosque in Abyar Ali, Al-Qiblatain Mosque, and the cultural center. The authority called on companies to meet the service requirements, including facility licenses, permits, and staff health certificates while submitting the applications.
